reviewer: Codex static source/configuration review at the user's request
scope: First supervised suspended HIM motor trial; operator keeps sticks centered and stops after 2-3 seconds of policy
training_metadata_assumption: User accepted default Go1 config: https://github.com/et26-sjc/HIMLoco-Go1/tree/c59f76349c4718da19aa9b055a830ac1a383f038 ; order basis mujoco_sim2sim/config.py; actual training-run DOF dump unavailable
physical_review_reference: project-relative go1_gym_deploy/configs/evidence/himloco_go1_physical_review_20261025.json SHA256=b64b1a472cbfba6909a7e6e1ba690f0be3ff4e60724ca6c05a5b72ac7e374c23; manual coarse identity/sign review of all 12 joints; RR_hip wrong-side motion corrected within capture; coupling/early returns retained; strict automatic report unchanged; no encoder-zero calibration

parameter_review.nominal_pd: Kp=40, Kd=1 as in the audited Go1 training contract; WTW Kp=20 is not substituted
parameter_review.initial_calibration: 3-second position interpolation; first gains zero; gains ramp over 0.5 seconds
parameter_review.initial_pose_allowance: Measured folded pose allowance 0.2 rad only before/during calibration; targets remain inside URDF
parameter_review.handover: At least 6 actual settled hold observations; second R2 starts a 1-second zero-command action ramp
parameter_review.measured_tracking: 0.5 rad tracking-error stop for this first suspended trial; not an enforced torque limit
parameter_review.target_step: Existing 0.08 rad per 20 ms rejection retained; first policy trial may legitimately abort here
parameter_review.tilt: 0.5 rad from projected gravity; suspended body remains near level
parameter_review.command_limits: Low limits 0.15 m/s forward, 0.10 m/s lateral, 0.15 rad/s yaw; sticks stay centered initially
parameter_review.timing: 50 ms state, 100 ms command watchdog and RC reception, 40 ms allowed scheduler lateness retained
parameter_review.sdk: PositionLimit and PowerProtect factor 9 retained; changed targets or SDK protection latch stop
parameter_review.torque: No doubled feedforward PD: desired velocity and feedforward torque are zero; firmware torque-limit equivalence remains unverified

stop_semantics.L2: Stop request in every phase; also checked directly by the C++ bridge
stop_semantics.R2: Starts calibration in WAIT_R2, starts policy in READY, stops in other active phases
stop_semantics.Ctrl_C_python: Requests a latched stop after any commands were published
stop_semantics.after_stop: Restart BOTH bridge and Python before another attempt; no automatic rearming
stop_semantics.mechanical_support: Remain supported with legs clear; zero gains do not hold the body up or prove electrical shutdown

not_validated_by_this_review: HIM physical tracking and learned-policy closed-loop behavior
HIM RC axis directions during actual locomotion
Ground load bearing and free walking
